question: Does the frozen searched-action student from the passed teacher-forced scout produce more faithful full-turn opponent successor states when allowed to choose its own actions?
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, reply-search self-play root256/slate8/opponent64, sample turns whose round modulo8 is zero, action limit2400

maps.disjoint_from: fit6346000/64, teacher-forced validation6347000/32, pilot6345000/16, all earlier validation windows and untouched promotion seed6300000

policies: The source routed-v6 expert and frozen 792225-byte action-head student from the prior scout. For each native search candidate state, both choose argmax of their own legal-action logits and execute independently until the opponent turn ends or24 atomic actions have been taken. No teacher action is supplied after candidate state, no native search at inference.
state_replay: Export opt-in exact legal-action indices for the native reply-search self-play roll-in and each root candidate turn. Replay from the procedural generator in the existing Python vector environment and verify sampled root seat/round and candidate post-turn observation against the dataset before any response. Do not deserialize arbitrary game snapshots or mutate ordinary agents.
metrics: For paired noncensored candidate replies, compare absolute error of asinh(root-perspective native position_score/1000) relative to the searched opponent successor, equally aggregate candidate errors within each independent map, and use exact two-sided map sign test. Also report per-root-seat error, policy reply completion/censoring, full-turn action count, and agreement with native teacher's selected root candidate on slates where all alternatives have both autonomous scores. Terminal native scores are transformed identically and kept. Do not substitute search or teacher continuations online.
decision_rule: Advance to a fresh full-game BOTH-seat matched test only if student has smaller per-map transformed successor-score error on a strict majority of informative maps with sign p<0.05, neither root-seat stratum has higher aggregate paired error, student reply censoring is no more frequent than source, and native teacher root-selection agreement does not fall. Otherwise reject this student for promotion without threshold or hyperparameter tuning on these maps.
qualification: This probe measures fidelity to the native searched one-turn response objective, not complete-game strength or Elo. Even if it passes, promotion requires fresh complete both-seat independent-map games against both direct source and search teacher with wall-time/profile checks; reserve seed6300000 until then.
resource_limit: Heavy execution only on SSH server after aggregate check, nice19 one CPU process at a time, no GPU, dataset gzip under20MB, autonomous probe hard timeout30 minutes and tiny JSON report. Do not preempt other workloads or inspect private data.
